name: tasks
description: Team tasks with status, assignee, due date, priority, projects, comments and history. Tasks link to items in other apps and can be created from a wiki page or a deal. For people and agents.

requiredTables.name: tasks
requiredTables.description: Team tasks: title, description, status (todo, in_progress, done), priority, assignee email, due date, project, who completed it, the item of another app it was created from (reference only), creator and timestamps.

requiredTables.name: projects
requiredTables.description: Projects that group tasks: name (unique, case-insensitive), description, creator.

requiredTables.name: task_comments
requiredTables.description: Comments on a task: body, author, timestamp.

requiredTables.name: task_events
requiredTables.description: History of a task: who changed which field from what to what, and when.

requiredTables.name: event_outbox
requiredTables.description: Events waiting to be delivered to the platform (task assigned, commented, status changed): one row per event, written in the same transaction as the change, with attempts and the last error. Deleted after delivery.

requiredTables.name: refs_outbox
requiredTables.description: References waiting to be delivered to the platform (set_refs): one row per task with the full set of its outgoing references (from description, comments and the item it was created from), written in the same transaction as the change. Deleted after delivery.

offeredTools.name: tasks.list
offeredTools.description: Lists tasks, in progress first, then to do, done last; open ones by due date. Optional filters: mine (true = assigned to you, use it for 'my open tasks' with completed false), assignee (email), unassigned, status (todo, in_progress, done), completed, overdue, projectId, query (text in title or description), limit (1-200, default 50). Returns { tasks } with id, status, assignee, dueDate, overdue, priority, projectName.

offeredTools.name: tasks.get
offeredTools.description: Returns one task with its comments and its history. Argument: id (UUID from tasks.list). Returns { task, comments: [{ id, body, author, createdAt }], history: [{ kind, from, to, actor, createdAt }] }. An unknown id returns 404.

offeredTools.name: tasks.create
offeredTools.description: Creates a task. Arguments: title (required, 1-200 chars), description, assignee (email), dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD), priority (low, medium, high; default medium), status (default todo), projectId (UUID from projects.list). The caller is stored as creator. Returns { task }. Check with tasks.list (query) first whether it already exists.

offeredTools.name: tasks.update
offeredTools.description: Changes a task. Arguments: id, plus at least one of title, description, assignee (email or null), dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD or null), priority, status (todo, in_progress, done), projectId (UUID or null). Optional expectedStatus: only change if the status is still this one. Every change lands in the history. Returns { task, changed, previousStatus }.

offeredTools.name: tasks.assign
offeredTools.description: Assigns a task to a person by email, or unassigns it with assignee null. Arguments: id (UUID from tasks.list), assignee. The platform notifies the person in their inbox (Home) if they may open Tasks. Returns { task, changed, previousStatus }; changed is false if the task already had this assignee.

offeredTools.name: tasks.complete
offeredTools.description: Sets a task to done and records who completed it and when. Argument: id. If it is already done, nothing changes (changed: false). Returns { task, changed, previousStatus }. To undo, call tasks.update with status previousStatus and expectedStatus done.

offeredTools.name: tasks.comment
offeredTools.description: Adds a comment to a task. Arguments: id (UUID of the task), body (1-5000 chars, plain text). The caller is stored as author. Comments cannot be edited or deleted. Returns { comment }. An unknown id returns 404.

offeredTools.name: tasks.create_from_ref
offeredTools.description: Creates a task from an item of another app, for example a wiki page section or a deal. Arguments: sourceRef (required, a reference wiki:page:<id> or crm:deal:<id>), excerpt (optional short text, up to 2000 characters, becomes the description; its first line is the title if title is missing), title, assignee (email), dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD), priority, status, projectId. The task links back to the source: list_backlinks of the source shows it with kind derived. Returns { task }.

offeredTools.name: tasks.resolve
offeredTools.description: Resolves references to tasks and projects for chips in other apps. Arguments: type (task or project), ids (1 to 50 ids). Returns { objects: [{ id, title, path, status, updatedAt }] }; unknown ids are left out. The platform calls it for resolve_refs after checking that the viewer may read Tasks.

offeredTools.name: projects.list
offeredTools.description: Lists all projects by name with counts: openCount, overdueCount, doneCount. No arguments. Returns { projects: [{ id, name, description, openCount, overdueCount, doneCount, createdBy, createdAt }] }. You need the id for projectId in tasks.create, tasks.update and tasks.list.

offeredTools.name: projects.create
offeredTools.description: Creates a project to group tasks. Arguments: name (required, 1-100 chars, unique ignoring case), description (up to 1000 chars). Returns { project }. If the name already exists, it returns 400 with a hint; use projects.list to get the existing id.

offeredTools.name: search
offeredTools.description: Searches tasks (title, description) and projects (name, description) at once, case-insensitive. Arguments: query (1 to 200 characters), limit (1 to 20, default 5). Returns {hits: [{id, title, snippet, url, kind}]}: kind is task or project, url the path in Tasks (/task/<id>, or /all?project=<id> for a project), snippet the status and project. Titles starting with the query first, open tasks before done ones. The tool of Tasks for the platform search.

events.description: A task was assigned to someone. Goes to the new assignee.
Someone commented on a task. Goes to its assignee and its creator.
The status of a task changed. Goes to its assignee and its creator.

objects.description: A task with title and status. Reference: tasks:task:<id>.
A project that groups tasks. Reference: tasks:project:<id>.

requestedGrants.reason: Who may open the app. Which group is decided by the grant in the control plane — a requested right is an application, not a grant.
Tasks reports assignments, comments and status changes to the platform inbox. Without this grant events wait in the outbox; saving a task is never affected.

Tasks reports the references in a task (links in description and comments, the item it was created from) so they show up as backlinks and mentions in other apps. Without this grant references wait in the outbox; saving a task is never affected.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Connection to the app's own schema, with the app role. Set by the control plane.

env.name: DATABASE_SCHEMA
env.description: The app's own schema. The SDK derives the search_path from it; a DSN with options= is rejected.

env.name: OPENAPPS_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: The app's own secret, used by the SDK to verify the gateway signature. Set by the control plane per deployment.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_ID
env.description: Id of this app in the signature material. Must match byte-for-byte what the gateway writes.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_HOST
env.description: Shared domain in the signature material, trimmed and lowercased.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_BASE_PATH
env.description: Path the app lives under (/tasks). Must be set at build time, otherwise links and images point nowhere.

env.name: OPENAPPS_PLATFORM_URL
env.description: Address of the control plane in the platform network. The SDK delivers events and references through it. Set by the control plane.

env.name: OPENAPPS_CALL_SECRET
env.description: The app's own secret for calls to the platform. Set by the control plane per deployment; never logged.

egress.reason: Events and references go to the platform through the control plane (OPENAPPS_PLATFORM_URL).
